title: clearance-accepts-a-recorded-approval
intention: Clearance accepts a hollow reading of {"approved": qid} as covered only when that question is resolved, bound to this ticket, and answered by Akien, so the tester's recorded approval is checked again at PROVED rather than trusted.
why: Measured 2026-10-06: 45c168cc1ff1's build wrote only its two proofs, so its hollow skipped both as the instrument and sealed {} (0 measured), and clearance refuses hollow_nothing_measured forever: no repair of the code can give it something to revert. Akien already approved that proof change (open-728473f9b70d). The lived symptom: a ticket he said yes to cannot cross PROVED, and the only ways past are faking writes_to or weakening the gate. Ruling 8p (2026-10-06): his approval is the measurement; the tester asks for it and records it, and clearance accepts the recorded proving.
traces_to: Law 8 (the gate re-checks what a peer recorded, then trusts it), Law 10 (his answer is the measurement), Law 4 (the rule is enforced at the gate, not as policy), RULE 1 (question tool via its public_interface).
how: In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py hollow_lacks: add a keyword parameter question_root=None. A file whose reading is a dict with a non-blank 'approved' string is read through cairn.tools.question.question.read(qid, root=question_root). It is covered if the record is resolved, its ticket == tid, and answered_by starts with 'Akien'. Otherwise a new lack hollow_approval_unresolved names the files and why. Approved files (covered or not) are excluded from `unreadable`. An empty reading {} stays hollow_nothing_measured. New teeth in a new proof cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_clearance_accepts_a_recorded_approval.py.
falsifier: RED if, against a scratch question store: (1) {"approved": qid} with qid resolved, bound to the ticket, answered by Akien yields any hollow lack; (2) the same with qid answered by cc, unresolved, bound to another ticket, or nonexistent yields no hollow_approval_unresolved; (3) {} yields anything but hollow_nothing_measured; (4) the standing clearance proofs (test_clearance*.py, the notified tooth of 0069ce6b8681) go red.
watchme: none, because every refusal prints at the PROVED crossing through harbor clear() (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py), and the tester's ask stands in the question inbox (cairn question list)
children: none, because the change is one function (hollow_lacks) plus one proof
decision_lines: D1 (8p, Akien 2026-10-06, via peer akiendelllinux_cc_0): when a build's hollow can measure nothing because every writes_to file is the ticket's own proof, the tester asks Akien; his approval is the measurement (Law 10), recorded as the proving, and clearance accepts it.
D2 (8p refinement 1, agreed): the question belongs at ticketing (8i); the tester asks at measurement time only when none was answered.
D3 (8p refinement 2, agreed): open-728473f9b70d is 45c168cc1ff1's yes; the tester records it as 45c1's proving.
D4: an empty hollow for any other reason stays hollow_nothing_measured and red; 763379e32e3b tooth 3 narrows to 'proofs-only without a recorded approval stays red', cleared by 8p itself.

decisions.text: Steps (9) and (10) fill their placeholders from earlier output, never from a message file: <build sha from step 5> is the full sha printed by git log -1 --format=%H right after step (5)'s commit (the one commit whose subject starts 'ec4ca415f43d: build'); '<the step 6 summary line verbatim>' is the bin/cairn test --seal summary line from step (6)'s stdout, the one beginning '1 proofs ·'; '<the step 8 summary line verbatim>' is the last non-blank summary line bin/cairn test --hollow printed to stdout in step (8); '<the step 5 VERIFY line verbatim>' is the single line verify_8p.py C printed to stdout in step (5), beginning 'VERIFY GREEN ec4ca415f43d'. The msg_8pC_*.txt files are commit messages only and are never read for these values.

Two rules for every commit and every placeholder in D5. (a) CairnCommons staging: in every step that commits CairnCommons, git add exactly those of these paths that git status --short lists as modified or new — tickets/ec4ca415f43d-clearance-accepts-a-recorded-approval.json, .artifact-journal.jsonl, rehearsals/ec4ca415f43d-*.json — and nothing else (never intentions-congruency-lab/, never another ticket's file); if none is listed the CairnCommons commit is skipped. In cairn, git add exactly the paths the step names. Where a step names one message file for both repos, both commits use that same file; where it names two (msg_8pC_<x>.txt and msg_8pC_<x>_commons.txt), cairn takes the first and CairnCommons the second. (b) Captured output: steps (5), (6) and (8) each run with stdout and stderr piped through tee into out_8pC_step5.txt, out_8pC_step6.txt and out_8pC_step8.txt in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-akien-dev-src-cairn/462a6e82-2573-46ef-8f40-d13459d02813/scratchpad; steps (9) and (10) read their placeholders from those files (D7 names which line), and the build sha is git log -1 --format=%H taken right after step (5)'s commit and appended to out_8pC_step5.txt by echo. No step is re-run to regenerate a value.

Measured 2026-10-06 by cairn.tools.question.question.read('open-728473f9b70d') against the live store: the file CairnCommons/questions/open-728473f9b70d.json exists; ticket '45c168cc1ff1', resolved True, answered_by 'Akien, recorded by caller class cc', answered_at '2026-10-06T10:19:57-06:00'. So _approval_holds('45c168cc1ff1', 'open-728473f9b70d', None) has every field it reads, and verify_8p.py C (step 5) re-measures exactly that, exiting 1 if any field has changed. This ticket builds clearance only; the tester's retrieval and recording of that approval is f5bba1daa72a's build, and 45c1's re-hollow runs after both children are PROVED. Nothing in this voyage writes to that question.
